classification.difficultyReason: Interpret corresponding heights and bases in shadow and sight-line diagrams; the supplied redraw scaffolds guide adding ground segments before applying a routine similarity ratio.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A 1 m high post casts a 2 m long shadow. How tall is the tree that casts an 8 m long shadow?

spec.description: Original triangle left, image triangle right; vertical sides on the right, dashed rays and right-angle markers. Decorative tree silhouette omitted.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding shadow lengths 8 m and 2 m; corresponding heights h and 1 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown height remains h; supplied answer hidden.

answer.worked:
Corresponding heights and shadows are in the same ratio.
$$\begin{aligned}k&=\frac{8}{2}=4\\h&=1\times4\\h&=4\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$
